tables.access: PostGIS extension catalog (owner supabase_admin, pg_depend on extension postgis)
tables.reason: extension-owned PostGIS reference table (public EPSG coordinate systems, no user data). Owner is supabase_admin and the anon/authenticated grants were issued by supabase_admin: ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE RLS is refused and a REVOKE run as postgres leaves anon INSERT=true (tested inside a rolled-back transaction 2026-10-06). The only full remedy is moving PostGIS out of public, which means dropping and recreating the extension under live geometry columns; not done.
